chunks.text: # Claims and appeals If the plan denies a claim or a request for prior authorization, the member receives a written notice explaining the reason and how to appeal. A member has 180 days from the date of the denial notice to file an appeal. The plan decides standard appeals within 30 days.

an appeal. The plan decides standard appeals within 30 days. If waiting could seriously harm the member's health, the member can ask for an expedited appeal, which is decided within 72 hours. If the plan upholds the denial, the member can request an external review by an independent organization within 4 months of the final decision.

# Dental benefit Two cleanings and two routine exams per calendar year are covered at 100 percent. X-rays are covered once every 12 months. Fillings and simple extractions are covered at 80 percent after the dental deductible of $50. Crowns, bridges and root canals are covered at 50 percent.

Crowns, bridges and root canals are covered at 50 percent. The plan pays at most $1,500 in dental benefits per member per calendar year. Orthodontics is covered only for members under 19, with a lifetime maximum of $2,000.
# Emergency care Members can go to any emergency room, in or out of network, when they believe their life or health is at serious risk. Emergency visits never need prior authorization.

# Maternity and newborn care Prenatal visits, routine ultrasounds and lab tests during pregnancy are covered at 100 percent with no co-pay when the member uses a network provider.

with no co-pay when the member uses a network provider. The hospital stay for delivery is covered for up to 2 days after a vaginal birth and up to 4 days after a cesarean section. A longer stay needs approval from the plan's care team.

A longer stay needs approval from the plan's care team. A newborn is covered from the day of birth, but the member must add the baby to the plan within 30 days of the birth. Babies added after 30 days start coverage on the first day of the next month.

# Mental health and substance use Outpatient therapy with a network therapist has a $20 co-pay per session, and there is no limit on the number of sessions when they are medically necessary. Inpatient mental health and substance use treatment requires prior authorization, except in an emergency.

substance use treatment requires prior authorization, except in an emergency. Members and their family can call the 24-hour crisis line at any time. The call is free and confidential. The employee assistance program offers up to 5 free counseling sessions per issue, per year, without using the medical benefit.

# Out-of-network reimbursement Care from providers outside the network is covered at 60 percent of the allowed amount after the out-of-network deductible of $1,000 per person. To be reimbursed, the member submits an itemized bill and proof of payment through the member portal within 365 days of the date of service.

member portal within 365 days of the date of service. The plan pays reimbursements by direct deposit within 15 business days after it approves a complete claim. Out-of-network providers may bill the member for the difference between their charge and the allowed amount, except for emergency care.

# Prescription drugs The plan uses a three-tier formulary. Tier 1 covers generic drugs with a $10 co-pay for a 30-day supply. Tier 2 covers preferred brand drugs with a $35 co-pay. Tier 3 covers non-preferred brand drugs with a $70 co-pay.

Tier 3 covers non-preferred brand drugs with a $70 co-pay. Maintenance drugs taken every day, such as blood pressure or cholesterol medication, can be ordered by mail for a 90-day supply at two times the 30-day co-pay.

for a 90-day supply at two times the 30-day co-pay. Specialty drugs, such as biologics, must be filled through the plan's specialty pharmacy and require prior authorization. The member pays 20 percent coinsurance, capped at $250 per fill.

# Telehealth Members can see a doctor by video or phone 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, through the plan's telehealth app. The first 6 telehealth visits in each calendar year are free. After that, each visit costs $15.

They cannot prescribe controlled substances. Virtual visits with a licensed therapist are also available through the app and follow the mental health benefit rules.
